entities.name: Chiyomatsu Ishikawa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ishikawa Chiyomatsu  was a Japanese biologist, zoologist, evolutionary theorist, and ichthyologist at the Naples Zoological Station starting 1887. He was responsible for disseminating Darwin's ideas on evolution in Japan.
